flashcards.en: The child is happy.
The child is playing.

flashcards.fa: یک کودک در حال خواندن کتاب است.
flashcards.en: A child is reading a book.
The child is with the family.

flashcards.fa: هر کودکی به محبت نیاز دارد.
flashcards.en: Every child needs love.
The child learns fast.

flashcards.fa: یک کودک خوب به دیگران کمک می‌کند.
flashcards.en: A good child helps others.

flashcards.fa: کودک هر روز به مدرسه می‌رود.
flashcards.en: The child goes to school every day.
The child wants a new toy.
Every child has a dream.
This is my house.
My house is big.
The house is clean.

flashcards.fa: ما در یک خانه کوچک زندگی می‌کنیم.
flashcards.en: We live in a small house.
The house has a beautiful garden.
My family is in the house.
The new house is near the park.
I want to buy a new house.

flashcards.fa: یک خانه با عشق به یک منزل واقعی تبدیل می‌شود.
flashcards.en: A house becomes a home with love.

flashcards.fa: خانه ما همیشه پر از شادی است.
flashcards.en: Our house is always full of happiness.
This is my school.
My school is near my house.
The school is big.

flashcards.fa: من هر صبح به مدرسه می‌روم.
flashcards.en: I go to school every morning.
The school has many students.

flashcards.fa: مدرسه من تمیز و امن است.
flashcards.en: My school is clean and safe.

flashcards.fa: ما در مدرسه چیزهای جدید یاد می‌گیریم.
flashcards.en: We learn new things at school.
The teacher is at school.

flashcards.fa: مدرسه به کودکان کمک می‌کند آینده بهتری بسازند.
flashcards.en: School helps children build a better future.

flashcards.fa: هر مدرسه‌ای به معلمان خوب نیاز دارد.
flashcards.en: Every school needs good teachers.
This is a book.
The book is new.

flashcards.fa: من این کتاب را دوست دارم.
flashcards.en: I like this book.

flashcards.fa: او هر شب یک کتاب می‌خواند.
flashcards.en: She reads a book every night.
This book is easy to read.

flashcards.fa: یک کتاب خوب چیزهای زیادی یاد می‌دهد.
flashcards.en: A good book teaches many things.
The book is on the table.

flashcards.fa: کتاب خواندن تو را باهوش‌تر می‌کند.
flashcards.en: Reading books makes you smarter.
I bought a beautiful book yesterday.

flashcards.fa: هر کتاب داستان متفاوتی را تعریف می‌کند.
flashcards.en: Every book tells a different story.
This is my car.
My car is fast.
The car is new.
He drives a big car.
The car is clean.
We travel by car.
My father bought a new car.

flashcards.fa: ماشین نزدیک خانه پارک شده است.
flashcards.en: The car is parked near the house.

flashcards.fa: رانندگی با دقت همه را ایمن نگه می‌دارد.
flashcards.en: Driving carefully keeps everyone safe.

flashcards.fa: یک ماشین خوب به مراقبت منظم نیاز دارد.
flashcards.en: A good car needs regular care.
